models.name: Solar Mini 4
models._note: Upstage Solar Mini 4 (API model solar-mini4, version solar-mini4-260922 "Released on 2026-09-22" per the Upstage console docs; launch blog 2026-10-01). Pretrained in-house by Upstage, MoE with 35B total / 3B active parameters, 512K context and up to 128K output tokens (AA lists 1,048,576 context — Upstage docs value used), training cutoff Feb 2026, Korean / English / Japanese. Reasoning off by default, adjustable via reasoning_effort; JSON mode, JSON Schema structured outputs, tool calling and parallel tool calls. Not open-weight (AA: proprietary) but available on-premises (quantized fits one H100 80GB). List price $0.10 input / $0.01 cached input / $0.40 output per M tokens (Upstage console 70% off through 2026-10-10 UTC). Available on Upstage Console API, Solar Chat, OpenRouter and on-prem. AA Intelligence Index v4.3.2 24.05 — highest of the 3B-active models AA has scored.
